newsitem.title: USA: FMR group cuts America West stake.
newsitem.headline: FMR group cuts America West stake.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp, parent of the investment adviser to Fidelity Funds, said it cut its stake in America West Airlines Inc to the equivalent of 5,174,338 class B common shares or 11.8 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold a net of 802,800 class B shares of America West between July 16 and September 11 at prices ranging from $12.61 to $17.00 a share.
In addition, the group said it sold a net of 12,400 warrants to purchase the class B shares at prices ranging from $6.38 to $7.13 a share.
